title: Harm
summary: H'ARM, noun 1. Injury; hurt; damage; detriment. Do thyself no harm Acts 16:28. He shall make amends for the harm he hath done in the holy thing. Leviticus 5:16. 2. Moral wrong; evil; mischief; wickedn

inlines.v: H'ARM, noun 1. Injury; hurt; damage; detriment. Do thyself no harm Acts 16:28. He shall make amends for the harm he hath done in the holy thing. Leviticus 5:16. 2. Moral wrong; evil; mischief; wickedness; a popular sense of the word. H'ARM, verb transitive To hurt; to injure; to damage; to impair soundness of body, either animal or vegetable.
